source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) ends, if this unit is in an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)'s range and you control that marker, you keep control of it until, as some phase ends, your opponent has a higher [Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) over it than you.

detail.condition: unit within range of an objective marker you control

effect.until: opponent's Level of Control over it exceeds yours at the end of a phase
